name: MVI-Bench
description: MVI-Bench evaluates model performance on multimodal visual understanding and instruction-following tasks using image and/or video inputs. It measures abilities such as visual question answering, object recognition, temporal reasoning, and instruction compliance in grounded visual contexts. Models are scored by comparing generated outputs to references across a variety of vision-guided prompts.
reputation: Relatively new and niche; limited widespread community adoption but used by researchers focused on multimodal vision-and-language evaluation.
